title: Executive Master Of Business Administration in London 2027
longDescription:
The EMBA equips professionals with the tools to navigate dynamic markets and foster competitive advantage. Through strategic frameworks and leadership development, participants will enhance their ability to inspire teams, optimize resources, and implement effective organizational practices. The program emphasizes innovation, financial acumen, and data-driven solutions to address complex business challenges. Additionally, participants will refine their understanding of human behavior and organizational structures to drive operational efficiency and collaboration.

The MBA curriculum consists of at least 72 ECTS credits of postgraduate study, offered as modular fashion. MBA-candidates in the short programme complete 10 required modules/courses (60 ECTS credits), plus a final Thesis/Dissertation (12 ECTS credits) or 2 additional modules (6 ECTS credits each) all of these focused on a specific field or industry of management.
courseDetails: Course Details This programme integrates strategic management, leadership, financial planning, and marketing to foster organizational excellence. Participants will explore organizational theory, behavioural insights, and entrepreneurial innovation. By combining practical and theoretical approaches, this EMBA prepares leaders to adapt to global challenges and create impactful solutions. Students will emerge equipped to lead teams, manage resources, and drive sustainable growth. Upon the completion of the course, you will be able to learn the following: Develop the ability to assess and implement strategic frameworks that ensure organizational competitiveness and adaptability in changing markets. Develop leadership approaches that foster innovation, align team efforts, and drive long-term organizational success. Analyze HR policies and practices to foster employee engagement and ensure alignment with organizational goals. Apply strategic financial planning techniques to optimize investment and manage organizational financial resources. Design effective marketing strategies to build competitive advantage by leveraging market trends and consumer insights. Utilize advanced research techniques to investigate business challenges and create data-informed solutions. Develop the ability to analyze and implement key management principles to enhance organizational performance and competitiveness. Understand and evaluate key organizational structures and processes to improve efficiency and adaptability. Analyze human behaviour within organizations to foster teamwork, motivation, and a positive work environment. Develop creative and entrepreneurial strategies to drive innovation and create sustainable business ventures.

modules.title: THESIS IN EXECUTIVE MASTER OF BUSINESS ADMINISTRATION
modules.summary: The thesis in EMBA allows students to conduct in-depth research on a strategic business topic, demonstrating their ability to apply advanced management concepts and frameworks to real-world organizational challenges.

entry: You are required to hold at minimum a recognised bachelor’s degree with a minimum overall score of 55% (GPA 2.0 on a 4.0 point scale) or higher.

In some instances, you may also require relevant work experience and/or research experience. If applicable, you may demonstrate this through the submission of a CV, portfolio, and/or a personal statement.
Our programs are conducted in English language. As such, you must demonstrate proficiency in English language by submitting one of the following test scores during the application process:
IELTS Overall: 5.5TOEFL (iBT: 58+; PBT: 490+; CBT: 167+)TOEIC Overall: 555+PTE Overall: 50+Duolingo Overall: 90+

The English proficiency test is not required for the following candidates:– Native English Speakers, OR;– Applicants having completed their schooling in English (i.e. High School Diploma or IB), OR;– Applicants having completed their undergraduate or graduate studies in English, OR;– 2 years of work experience in an organization where English is the primary language of communication.
workshops: Workshops Workshops are conducted through live webinars for online students.
visa: Visa Requirements There is no Visa requirement for this programme.
library: Use the online learning resources collection provided by MSBM to unlock knowledge.

blocks.text: Entry Requirements
You are required to hold at minimum a recognised bachelor’s degree with a minimum overall score of 55% (GPA 2.0 on a 4.0 point scale) or higher.

In some instances, you may also require relevant work experience and/or research experience. If applicable, you may demonstrate this through the submission of a CV, portfolio, and/or a personal statement.
English Language Proficiency:
Our programs are conducted in English language. As such, you must demonstrate proficiency in English language by submitting one of the following test scores during the application process:
IELTS Overall: 5.5TOEFL (iBT: 58+; PBT: 490+; CBT: 167+)TOEIC Overall: 555+PTE Overall: 50+Duolingo Overall: 90+
English Proficiency Waivers:

The English proficiency test is not required for the following candidates:– Native English Speakers, OR;– Applicants having completed their schooling in English (i.e. High School Diploma or IB), OR;– Applicants having completed their undergraduate or graduate studies in English, OR;– 2 years of work experience in an organization where English is the primary language of communication.
